title: AI-controlled ship template
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Defines the AI-controlled ship entity type. This overlay template co-locates with the base ship.json in the same directory and adds AI behavioral parameters. Per ADR-0038, templates are loaded and validated independently of the world definition.

Physical quantities follow ADR-0008 (value+unit objects). Allowed units are defined in the central units registry (assets/json/schema/units.schema.json).

ai.description: AI behavioral parameters. These depend on the ship type -- a fighter has different values than a cargo ship.

aggro_range.description: Distance in metres at which the AI becomes hostile and pursues.

attack_range.description: Distance in metres at which the AI starts attacking.

leash_range.description: Maximum distance in metres from patrol point before the AI returns.

flee_health_threshold.description: Health fraction (0-1) below which the AI flees from combat. 0.25 = flee at 25% health.

patrol_radius.description: Radius in metres for patrol wander behaviour.
